correctness.rationale: A necessary-and-sufficient distance-two criterion is taken from arXiv:2307.05168. Direct proof shows every selected induced component is a one-coordinate clique or singleton and different components consume disjoint labels in all three alphabets; the converse is immediate from Hamming distances 1 and 3. The labeled multitype exponential formula and positive integer recurrence count each set exactly once. The sharp maximum proofs cover all quantified ranges, including the c=2 and c>=5 boundaries. The included standard-library verifier replays the original shortest-path predicate for all subsets of two small boards, exhausts distance-two conflict counts for five boards, and checks claimed large-parameter top coefficients. Finite tests are corroboration, not proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The 2023 structural classification entails possible block types but not a stated explicit all-size evaluation; the standard exponential construction is carried out for all labeled alphabet sizes here. General inclusion-exclusion in 2025 is not a precomputed expression for this family. There is substantive mathematical dependence, openly credited, but no identified theorem already evaluating every coefficient.

value.rationale: A standard infinite three-parameter Hamming family gains the complete labeled all-cardinality total-visibility polynomial and a positive recurrence; previously available statements supplied the scalar maximum but not the distribution or maximum-set census. The top coefficients give exact labeled optimizer counts and symmetry orbits in two robust ranges, including an explicit thin-factor transition. Those natural invariant counts are useful independently of a larger theorem, with the known component structure and narrower priority claim fully disclosed.
